# Legacy Codebase — Route Map

THIS IS A LEGACY CODEBASE. Read CLAUDE.md before doing anything.

## Conventions and rules

- /CLAUDE.md            — Project memory (read first; longer than greenfield)
- /AGENTS.md            — Cross-vendor agent guidance (mirrors CLAUDE.md)
- /BROWNFIELD_PLAN.md   — 90-day brownfield migration plan
- /MVH_LEVELS.md        — Maturity scoring rubric (level 1-4)

## What's known vs. unknown

- /docs/architecture-as-known.md   — What we have documented (often partial)
- /docs/architecture-as-feared.md  — What we suspect but cannot confirm (TBD)
- /docs/adr/                        — Architecture decision records (often empty)

## Modules — see CLAUDE.md § Module status

Each module has a row in the Module Status table in CLAUDE.md indicating
whether it is safe to AI-edit. Default for unlisted modules: NOT SAFE.

## Build and verify

- /legacy-bridge-scripts/discover.sh             — Auto-detect what's in the repo
- /legacy-bridge-scripts/golden-master-record.sh — Record current behavior of a module
- /legacy-bridge-scripts/legacy-verify.sh        — Verify command (adapts to what exists)

## Harness

- /.claude/settings.json       — Hooks wiring (heavy restrictions)
- /.claude/skills/             — Brownfield skills (strangler-pattern, characterize, read-only-discovery)
- /.claude/agents/             — legacy-explorer subagent
- /.claude/hooks/              — fence-new-violations, no-l3-in-legacy, legacy-protected-paths

## CI and PR

- /.github/workflows/legacy-verify.yml      — CI runs legacy-verify
- /.github/pull_request_template.md         — Brownfield-flavored checklist
